days.title: High Peaks and Glacial Lakes
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Monte Vettore
stops.detail: The highest mountain, as well as the highest peak in the Marche, is Monte Vettore which, with its 2476 m, dominates Castelluccio.

stops.name: Lago di Pilato
stops.detail: Located between the inaccessible and vertical walls immediately below the summit of Monte Vettore, Lake Pilato is one of the very few alpine-type glacial lakes present in the Apennines and the only lake of natural origin in the Marche.

days.title: Plateaus and Gorges
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Piani di Castelluccio
stops.detail: The western slope slopes gently towards Umbria with a successive series of high-altitude depressions, the famous Piani di Castelluccio.

stops.name: Gole dell'Infernaccio
stops.detail: The valley floors of rivers and streams are divided into narrow and impressive gorges (such as the suggestive Gole dell'Infernaccio), created by tectonic activities and erosion.
